Equestrian Portrait of Joachim Murat, King of Naples
29855752: Jean-Baptiste Isabey and His Daughter is a 1795 portrait painting by the French artist François Gérard.
29855883: The Storm is an oil on canvas painting by Jean-Honoré Fragonard that hangs in the Louvre, in Paris. Painted during his time in Rome, it was inspired by the caravan pictures of Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione that were particularly admired in Paris.
29857298: Christ and the Canaanite Woman is a 1784 religious history painting by the French artist Jean Germain Drouais.
29857714: The Murder of the Bishop of Liège is an oil painting on canvas created in 1829 by the French artist Eugène Delacroix, showing the murder of Louis de Bourbon, Bishop of Liège by William I de La Marck's men during the 15th-century Wars of Liège, as told in chapter 22 of Walter Scott's historical…
The Murder of the Bishop of Liège
29857773: The Shipwreck of Don Juan is an 1840 oil painting by the French artist Eugène Delacroix. It depicts a scene from Lord Byron's epic poem Don Juan.
29857809: Lion Devouring a Rabbit is an oil painting on canvas executed in 1853 by the French artist Eugène Delacroix, now in the Louvre in Paris.
29857821: Hamlet and Horatio in the Graveyard is an 1839 oil painting by the French artist Eugène Delacroix. It is inspired by a scene from William Shakespeare's Elizabethan tragedy Hamlet.
Hamlet and Horatio in the Graveyard

29862378: The Defeat of the Cimbri is an 1833 history painting by the French artist Alexandre-Gabriel Decamps. It depicts a scene from 102 BC during the Cimbrian War where forces of the Roman Republic led by Gaius Marius defeated the Germanic tribes from the Cimbri and Teutons.
29862474: The Three Women of Gand is an oil-on-canvas group portrait from the early 19th century, attributed to the circle or workshop of Jacques-Louis David. The painting is dated to around 1812 and is part of the collection of the Musée du Louvre, Paris.
29862982: Portrait of Prosper Marilhat is an 1835 portrait painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau. It depicts his fellow painter Prosper Marilhat known for his Orientalist scenes.
29862996: Othello and Desdemona in Venice is an oil painting on panel by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1850. Inspired by William Shakespeare's 1604 tragedy Othello, it depicts Othello and his wife, Desdemona amongst the canals of Venice.
29863002: Susanna and the Elders is an oil painting on panel by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1856. Combining religious and nude art it depicts the biblical scene of Susanna and the Elders, a popular subject in European Art.
29863006: Portrait of Dominique Lacordaire is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau, from 1840. It is held at the Louvre, in Paris.
30088321: The Osorkon Bust, also known as the Eliba'l Inscription, is a bust of Egyptian pharaoh Osorkon I, discovered in Byblos in the 19th century.
30593221: The bushel with ibex motifs, also known as the beaker with ibex motifs, is a prehistoric pottery artifact originating from Susa, an ancient city in the Near East located in modern-day Iran. This piece of art is believed to have been created during the Susa I period, between 4200 and 3500 BCE.
34749881: The Duchess of Berry and Her Children is an c.1822 portrait painting by the French artist François Gérard. It depicts the widowed Duchess of Berry with her two children Louise and Henri.
The Duchess of Berry and Her Children
37768457: The Mistress of the Animals or the Goddess feeding goats is a Late Bronze Age pyxis lid from Minet el-Beida (Ugarit), Syria depicting a divine female figure nourishing two goats, commonly referred to as a Potnia Theron motif.
47516400: The Bible Reading, Reading the Bible or The Father of a Family Reading the Bible to his Children is an oil on canvas genre painting by French artist Jean-Baptiste Greuze, from 1755.
50349942: Napoleon Pardoning the Rebels at Cairo is an 1808 history painting by the French artist Pierre-Narcisse Guérin. It depicts a scene on 23 October 1798 during the French invasion of Egypt.
Napoleon Pardoning the Rebels at Cairo
52725080: The sarcophagus of Eshmunazar II is a 6th-century BC sarcophagus unearthed in 1855 in the grounds of an ancient necropolis southeast of the city of Sidon, in modern-day Lebanon, that contained the body of Eshmunazar II, Phoenician King of Sidon.
55598970: The Petit chien à bélière - small bound dog - or Pendeloque au chien de Suse - dog pendant of Susa - is a pendant in the form of a dog. The pendant was found in the tell of the Susa acropolis and dates to around 3300 BCE - 3100 BCE.
56305333: Vulcan Chaining Prometheus is a 1744 oil on canvas painting by Jean-Charles Frontier, produced as his reception piece for the Académie Royale de peinture. It shows Jupiter ordering the eternal punishment of Prometheus, which Vulcan begins.
57530584: Saint Dominic is an oil on canvas painting of Saint Dominic by Titian, from c. 1565. It is held in the Galleria Borghese, in Rome.
59211717: Portrait of Jacques Cathelineau is an 1816 oil painting by the French artist Girodet. Combining elements of history painting and portraiture it depicts Jacques Cathelineau one of the leaders of the War in the Vendée, a major but unsuccessful uprising against the French Revolution.
59248135: Portrait of the Duchess of Angoulême is an 1816 portrait painting by the French artist Antoine-Jean Gros depicting Marie Thérèse of France. The only surviving child of the guillotined Louis XVI she returned to France following the defeat of Napoleon.
Portrait of the Duchess of Angoulême
59339697: Portrait of Louis-Claude Vassé is a 1771 portrait painting by the French artist Étienne Aubry. It depicts the celebrated sculptor Louis-Claude Vassé.
59339698: Portrait of Noël Hallé is a 1775 portrait painting by the French artist Étienne Aubry. It depicts the noted history painter Noël Hallé, a long-standing member of the French Royal Academy.
60835898: The Tête d'enfant de trois quarts à droite is a silverpoint drawing on paper by the Florentine painter Leonardo da Vinci. It belongs to the Codex Vallardi and is preserved at the Department of Graphic Arts of the Louvre Museum in Paris.
Tête d'enfant de trois quarts à droite
65086094: The Sosibios Vase is a Neo-Attic marble krater of the Hellenistic period. It is attributed by signature to Sosibios, a Greek sculptor who was active in Rome during the end of the Roman Republic, and is dated to approximately 50 BCE.
65519367: Portrait of Henri de la Rochejaquelein is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the French artist Pierre-Narcisse Guérin, from 1816.
Portrait of Henri de la Rochejaquelein
68496636: The Mocking of Christ is a small 13th-century panel painting by the Italian artist Cimabue, in tempera on a poplar panel. It depicts the mocking of Jesus and is one of three panels known from Cimabue's Diptych of Devotion.
78508506: The Separation of Saints Peter and Paul is a painting by the Italian Baroque painter Giovanni Lanfranco. It is housed in the Museum of Fine Arts of Carcassonne.
Separation of Saints Peter and Paul
85785643: The Miniature Altarpiece is a Gothic boxwood miniature in the form of a small altarpiece, made in the Netherlands c. 1520–1530, probably by the workshop of Adam Dircksz, about whom almost nothing is known. It has been held by the Louvre since 1901, but is not on public display.
87567802: The Neirab steles are two 7th-century BC steles with Aramaic inscriptions found in 1891 in Al-Nayrab near Aleppo, Syria. They are currently in the Louvre.
92985229: Saint Gregory with Saints or Pope Saint Gregory, Surrounded by Saints, Venerating the Miraculous Image of the Madonna and Child, known as the Santa Maria in Vallicella is a 1606-1607 oil on canvas painting by Peter Paul Rubens, now in the Musée de Grenoble.
97172954: The Duck candlestick, a candelabra with ducks and cats, is an object of Islamic art in hammered and embossed copper alloy, with an inlaid decoration of silver and red copper. It was produced in the medieval Persian world in the 12th century, during the Seljuk and Ghurid eras.
97910090: The Tomb of Valentina Balbiani is a white marble tomb sculpture constructed by the French sculptor Germain Pilon c. 1580 for Jeanne Valentine Balbiani (1518–1572), the Italian wife of the French statesman, chancellor and cardinal René de Birague (1506–1583).
99605375: Adonis, also known as Adonis Mazarin, is a marble sculpture by Flemish artist François Duquesnoy, who completed it in the early 17th century.
100998017: The Drapery Study for the Virgin is a drawing by Leonardo da Vinci in the Louvre.
101578575: The Yehawmilk stele, de Clercq stele, or Byblos stele, also known as KAI 10 and CIS I 1, is a Phoenician inscription from c.450 BC found in Byblos at the end of Ernest Renan's Mission de Phénicie. Yehawmilk, king of Byblos, dedicated the stele to the city’s protective goddess Ba'alat Gebal.
103993781: Saint John the Baptist Preaching is a 1562 oil-on-canvas painting of John the Baptist by Paolo Veronese, now in the Galleria Borghese in Rome. The painting depicts John the Baptist acting primarily and quite literally as a messenger for the coming of Jesus.
106107355: View of the Port of Brest is a 1794 landscape painting by the French artist Jean-François Hue. It depicts the harbour of Brest in Brittany.
View of the Port of Brest
106241116: Judith and Holofernes is an oil on canvas painting by Horace Vernet, from 1830. He was then director of the Académie de France à Rome It shows Judith just before beheading Holofernes.
106472304: The Arrest of Charlotte Corday is an 1830 history painting by the Dutch artist Hendrik Scheffer. Portraying a scene during the French Revolution, it depicts the arrest of Charlotte Corday following her assassination of the leading official Jean-Paul Marat.
107612614: The Palette Game is a c. 1761–1765 oil-on-canvas painting by Jean-Honoré Fragonard, showing an idyll with a happy company in a natural landscape dominated by ruins.
107612670: The See-Saw is an oil painting on canvas of c. 1761–1765 by Jean-Honoré Fragonard.
108101427: The Young River God with Three Putti is a marble sculpture of about 1548 by the Mannerist artist Pierino da Vinci, now in the Musée du Louvre in Paris. The 1.36 m –high sculpture shows a pensive young river god accompanied by three laughing putti carrying an urn.
Young River God with Three Putti
110300668: The Cherchell Neopunic inscriptions are two Neopunic inscriptions on marble discovered in 1875 and 1882 in Cherchell in French Algeria. They are currently in the Louvre, known as AO 1028 and AO 5294.
110485769: The Tyre Cistern inscription is a Phoenician inscription on a white marble block discovered in the castle-palace of the Old City of Tyre, Lebanon in 1885 and acquired by Peter Julius Löytved, the Danish vice-consul in Beirut.
111310014: The Saint Stephen Triptych is a 1616–1617 oil on panel painting by Peter Paul Rubens, produced as the high altarpiece for Saint-Amand Abbey, a Benedictine house near Valenciennes. It was seized during the French Revolution and is now in the Musée des Beaux Arts de Valenciennes.
112262592: The Port of Dunkirk is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French artist Eugène Isabey, from 1831. It depicts a view of the port town of Dunkirk on the North Sea of France close to the border with Belgium.
114918960: The Massacre of the Mamelukes is an 1819 history painting by the French artist Horace Vernet.
115649677: Jahangir with a Portrait of Akbar is a Mughal painting, by the artists Hashim and Abu'l Hasan. It was commissioned by the Mughal emperor Jahangir in the early 17th century.
Jahangir with a Portrait of Akbar
115669488: The Battle of the Alma is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist Eugène Lami, from 1855.
115669584: Juno in the Clouds is a c.1735 oval painting by Giovanni Battista Tiepolo, bought from a private owner for the Louvre Museum in 2020. It shows Juno and her peacock in a cloud, with a putto below.
115670073: President Molé Confronted by Insurgents is an oil on canvas history painting by the French artist François-André Vincent, from 1779.
115670936: Diana and Endymion, also known in French as Diane et Endymion, is an 1822 oil-on-canvas painting by Jérôme-Martin Langlois. The painting depicts the Roman goddess Diana, one of the twelve Gods and Goddesses of Olympus, falling in love with Endymion and is painted in the Neoclassical style.
115671751: Moorish Woman Leaving the Bath is an 1856 oil painting by the French artist Théodore Chassériau. Orientalist in tone, it combines element of genre painting and nude art.
115672481: The Soul Breaking the Links Holding it to the Earth is an oil on canvas allegorical painting by Pierre-Paul Prud'hon, begun in 1821 and left incomplete upon his death in 1823. It is held in the Louvre, in Paris.
The Soul Breaking the Links Holding it to the Earth
115673670: The Cupid Seller or The Accessories Seller is an oil on canvas painting by the French artist Joseph-Marie Vien, from 1763. One of the earliest works of French neo-classicism, it is based on an ancient fresco of the same name from Stabiae and shows a woman selling tiny cupids.
115674619: The Wedding of Leopold I of Belgium and Louise of Orléans is an 1837 history painting by the French artist Joseph-Désiré Court. It depicts the wedding between Leopold I of Belgium and Louise of Orléans that took place at the Château de Compiègne on 9 August 1832.
The Wedding of Leopold I of Belgium and Louise of Orléans
115674876: Bonaparte at the Council of Five Hundred at Saint-Cloud is an oil on canvas history painting by the French artist François Bouchot, from 1840.
Bonaparte at the Council of Five Hundred at Saint-Cloud
115675911: Assumption of the Virgin is an oil on canvas painting by Philippe de Champaigne, from 1638. It depicts the assumption of Mary, now in the Museum of Grenoble.
115676120: The Raising of Lazarus is a 1633 oil painting on canvas by the French painter Philippe de Champaigne, on long-term loan from the Louvre to the Museum of Grenoble, which also holds that artist's The Assumption, to which it was a pendant.
115676373: French Troops Fording the Magra is an oil on canvas painting by the British artist Clarkson Frederick Stanfield, from 1847.
115676396: Portrait of the Duke of Berry is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the French artist François Gérard, from 1820.
Portrait of the Duke of Berry
122389454: The Intervention of the Sabine Women is a 1781 history painting by the French artist François-André Vincent. It features a legendary scene from the founding period of Rome.
The Intervention of the Sabine Women (Vincent)
124474952: The Quintus Marcius trilingual inscription is a Latin-Greek-Punic trilingual inscription on stone, found in 1899 in Henchir-Alouin, near Uthina, in the outskirts of Tunis, Tunisia. The Phoenician script is dated between the fall of Carthage in 146 BC and the beginning of the Christian era.
131703323: Assumption of the Virgin is a 1580 oil on canvas painting by Paolo Veronese. Since 1803 it has been in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Dijon and it was transferred from the French state to the city of Dijon in 2010.
131703422: Admiral Coligny Confronts His Assassins or The Death of Coligny is an oil on canvas history painting by the Flemish artist Joseph-Benoît Suvée, from 1787.
136512845: The Bust of Girolamo Benivieni is a terracotta sculpture by Giovanni Bastianini, purportedly depicting the Florentine poet Girolamo Benivieni. The actual sitter was Giuseppe Bonaiuti, a seventy-year-old worker at a tobacco factory in Florence who was acquainted with the sculptor.
137187355: Jahangir Visiting the Ascetic Jadrup is a Mughal painting by the artist Govardhan, dated to about 1620. It depicts the lavishly dressed Mughal emperor Jahangir visiting the ascetic Jadrup, inside the latter's cave dwelling.
